newsitem.title: USA: Proffitt's Inc reorganizes after merger.
newsitem.headline: Proffitt's Inc reorganizes after merger.

text.p: Department store retailer Proffitt's Inc said Friday it is undergoing organizational changes in conjunction with its merger with Parisian Inc, completed October 11.
Parisian will operate as a separate department store division of Proffitt's with its divisional headquarters in Birmingham, Ala.

The company's three other department store divisions, Younkers, McRae's, and Proffitt's, have their divisional headquarters in Des Moines, Iowa, Jackson, Mississippi, and Knoxville, Tennessee, respectively.

R. Brad Martin will continue as chairman and chief executive officer of Proffitt's Inc. Donald Hess will continue as president and chief executive officer of the Parisian Division and has joined the board of Proffitt's.

Proffitt's also announced the formation of the Proffitt's Merchandising Group, to be headquartered in Birmingham, Alabama. The Group will coordinate merchandise planning, marketing, visual, and brand development for the Younkers, McRae's and Proffitt's Divisions.
